content_units: Toronto–Lisbon Best Flight Pick

Using your limits,   Option C is the most practical choice  . It is the only option that stays comfortably under your   15-hour preference each way  , includes the   checked bag  , avoids an   overnight layover  , and still fits within your   CAD 1200 max budget  .
Practical Option Ranking
Option   Total Cost   Outbound   Return   Stops   Bag Included   Constraint Fit
C       CAD 1180       7h05       7h40     Non-stop   Yes     Best overall fit
A       CAD 1095       13h40       14h10     1 stop   Yes     Runner-up
B   CAD 1070   17h50   18h20   2 stops   No initially; extra bag fee added   Fails time preference both ways
D   CAD 1040   15h20   16h05   1 stop   Yes   Fails time preference; overnight layover
Best choice: Option C
-   Why it wins:   Fastest by a wide margin and the simplest itinerary.
-   Budget check:   At   CAD 1180  , it is   within budget  .
-   Baggage check:   Includes   one checked bag  .
-   Comfort/practicality:   Non-stop both ways means lower disruption risk, less airport stress, and no layover concerns.
-   Time check:   Easily meets your target of   under 15 hours each way  .
Runner-up: Option A
-   Why it places second:   It also fits your budget, includes the checked bag, avoids the overnight-layover issue, and stays under your preferred travel-time cap in both directions.
-   Trade-off vs C:   It is much slower than Option C and adds a connection, but it saves   CAD 85  .
-   Best use case:   Sensible if you want to spend a bit less while still meeting all major constraints.
Why the others lose
-   Option B:   Lower base fare, but after the   CAD 90   bag fee it becomes   CAD 1070   and still has   2 stops   plus both directions exceed your preferred time limit.
-   Option D:   Good price and bag included, but it has a   9-hour overnight layover outbound   and also exceeds your time preference both ways.
Decision Guidance
If you want the   most practical overall flight  , choose   Option C  .
If you want the   best value while still meeting your stated constraints  , choose   Option A  .
